result.instructions: Tools for ShipSlip, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What does shipping insurance cost for a $250 parcel?"; "Insure FedEx tracking number 784122900163 for $250, shipped on 2026-07-02."; "File a damaged-goods claim on policy 9b1c for the crushed box.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ShipSlip data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shipslip_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shipslip_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shipslip_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shipslip_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shipslip_quote_insurance
tools.title: Quote shipping insurance
tools.description: Quote the insurance premium for one declared value. Creates nothing and charges nothing. The premium is $1 per $100 of declared value, rounded up, with coverage capped at $1000. ShipSlip API: POST /v1/insurance/quote.

item_value.description: Declared value in USD. Above 0 and at most 1000, the coverage cap.

tools.name: shipslip_create_policy
tools.title: Buy a shipping insurance policy
tools.description: BUYS INSURANCE: creates a live policy for one shipment at its declared value. Call only when the user asks to insure this exact shipment, after a quote from shipslip_quote_insurance. Set confirm_purchase to true only after the user approves the premium. Keep the returned id as policy_id for shipslip_file_claim. ShipSlip API: POST /v1/insurance/policy.

confirm_purchase.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves this policy and its premium.

carrier.description: Carrier: fedex, ups or usps (any letter case).

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number of the shipment.

order_number.description: Your internal order or reference number.

ship_date.description: Ship date, yyyy-mm-dd. Lost and missing claims count 20 days from this date.

item_value.description: Declared value in USD. Above 0 and at most 1000, the coverage cap.

tools.name: shipslip_file_claim
tools.title: File an insurance claim
tools.description: FILES A CLAIM on an active policy from shipslip_create_policy. Call only when the user asks to file this claim. Set confirm_filing to true only after the user approves it. Send policy_id, or tracking_number to use the latest active policy for it. Lost and missing claims need trace_initiated_date and 20 days after the ship date; ShipSlip returns days_remaining when the claim is early. Photos and documents are added in ShipSlip Dashboard > Protect. ShipSlip API: POST /v1/insurance/claims.

confirm_filing.description: Must be true. Set it only after the user approves filing this claim.

policy_id.description: Policy id from shipslip_create_policy. Preferred over tracking_number.

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number. Used only when policy_id is not sent.

claim_type.description: Claim type: lost, damaged or missing.

discovery_date.description: Date the loss or damage was found, yyyy-mm-dd.

trace_initiated_date.description: Date the carrier trace started, yyyy-mm-dd. Required for lost and missing claims.

description.description: What happened, in the customer's words.
